scope: Bounded comparison of already inspected exact public source versions; no broad new search or global novelty guarantee.
finding: The added implementation is distinct from the inspected compact-copy and fresh-output preparation interfaces. It performs equal-width overwrite of one track in an existing paired destination while retaining the other track, and executes the charged prepared-XOR-to-writeback composition.

closest_sources.head: 890b2906ebb76b3c9392a08d64e933630c06b1ac
closest_sources.existing: Nine-state two-tape compact counter copy. It blanks high source zeros, copies the compact prefix to a pristine output, and proves elapsed <=4n+4.
closest_sources.difference: It is prior paid physical copy. Its output is initially blank and its source is compacted; it does not state this existing paired-destination target-overwrite/other-track-preservation API.

closest_sources.head: 34eb901441affffaba76b00920f2f9cb05777117
closest_sources.existing: Four-tape paid input preparation with high-zero equalization and reversed work copies, preserving unsigned input values.
closest_sources.difference: Reused unchanged through PR1921. It supplies the preparation entrance, not the new target-track update of an existing marked block.

closest_sources.head: 69fefa9c2b2d3e5aa9bc11537537fd25ed3ea72c
closest_sources.existing: Actual PR488 preparation, backward paired-word creation and marked XOR on newly prepared output, with complete five-tape first halt and prefix-space bounds.
closest_sources.difference: Reused unchanged. The new module adds one paid transition into existing-slot writeback and retains the four original/work tapes during that execution.

limits: No claim of first physical copy, new XOR algebra, globally novel machinery or optimal constants.
Different earlier tape/transition models prevent treating their constants as directly interchangeable.
Equal destination capacity and marked isolated layout are inputs. Physical slot access, ambient framing, source-to-Cell bindings and overwritten-data restoration remain open.
